brief:
Learning objective: students write a boolean check with comparisons and build a short output text.
Target concept: conditions on doubles and string concatenation.
Target level: first-semester students after 3 weeks of Java.
Course phase: early.
Scenario: a room sensor has a comfortable temperature range; a program checks whether a reading lies
in the range and prints a one-line description of the range.
Constraints: one class, one or two tasks, at most six tests.
statement:
# Temperature Range

A room sensor reports the current temperature in degrees Celsius. The building manager has defined a
comfortable range for each room, given by a minimum and a maximum temperature. You complete the class
`TemperatureRange`, which checks a reading against the range and describes the range for the
sensor's display.

### Tasks

1. [task][Check a temperature]
   Implement `contains`, which returns `true` if a temperature lies between the minimum and the
   maximum of the range, and `false` otherwise.

2. [task][Describe the range]
   Implement `describe`, which returns a short one-line summary of the range that names its minimum
   and its maximum in degrees Celsius.
